text: dsh-fork-to-preset 是一个面向 DSH Web 客户端的会话操作插件，在每个会话页头加入 preset 选择框和分叉按钮。界面会读取可用 agent preset，用户选择目标后即可把当前会话分叉成由该 preset 运行的新会话，并自动打开新会话。它还提供本机 Web 路由返回 preset 列表，并在界面显示加载、错误和完成状态。适合需要把已有会话交给不同 agent preset 继续处理的场景；不需要额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-fork-to-preset adds an agent preset picker and fork button to the DSH web conversation header. Choose a preset to create and open a new session from the current one. The host provides the preset list; the UI shows loading and error states. No API key or external service is configured.
我想把当前 DSH 会话交给另一个 agent preset 接着处理。
能不能从对话页头挑一个 preset，直接分叉出新会话？
I need to branch this conversation into a fresh session with a different agent preset.
dsh-fork-to-preset 的功能「按 preset 分叉会话」：在会话页头选择目标 agent preset 并点击分叉按钮，创建使用该 preset 的新会话；新会话创建成功后会自动打开。
dsh-fork-to-preset 的功能「查看可用 preset」：会话页头的选择框加载 agent preset 名称；主机端路由查询 preset 列表并返回标识、名称、描述和默认项状态。

dsh-fork-to-preset README · dsh-fork-to-preset：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that adds a **"Fork to preset"** button to every conversation's header. Pick any agent preset from the roster and fork the current session into a fresh independent child session running under that preset — inheriting the parent's completed turns.

dsh-fork-to-preset README · How it works：- Click the **↴ Fork to preset** dropdown in the conversation header
- Select a target agent preset from the roster
- Click the button → a new session opens, mounted on the chosen preset, with the parent's completed-turn history

dsh-fork-to-preset README · Distribution：**GitHub-only.** Not published to npm. Install by mounting the package directory with a `cordis.patch.yml` bundle declaration.

Requires a platform that has the `session.fork({ agentPreset })` API (DeepSeek Harness rc.8+).
